name: Kengore
summary: Kengore is a high-tech warrior who uses energy weaponry including laser eyes, a shoulder-mounted plasma cannon, and devastating orbital strikes.

source.parsed_text:
Kengore is ...


Special moves:
- Laser eyes that burn the player, cool down is very low for this so he can use it frequently
- Shoulder mounted plasma cannon, he positions his body to fire, activating from his wrist computer, cool down is very low for this so he can use it frequently
- Ultimate move: orbital lasers, activated from his wrist computer, a giant beam comes down from the sky to destroy the other character

inferred_stats.reason: High offensive capability from ranged high-energy weaponry paired with standard durability.

victory_pose: Kengore stands tall, crosses their arms, and lets out a brief burst of energy from their eyes.
taunts: Is that the best you've got?

specials.description: Laser eyes that burn the player, cool down is very low for this so he can use it frequently
pose_frames: Leaning back slightly while gathering energy in the eyes
Thrusting the head forward as twin beams shoot out
